name: data-preparation-skills
description: Agent Skills for reproducible data preparation: scripted downloads with provenance and validation, RO-Crate 1.3 metadata with Process Run Crate actions, and investigating data licences.

author.name: Stian Soiland-Reyes, The University of Manchester

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible data downloads, RO-Crate provenance and licence checks
interface.longDescription: Three skills for preparing external data for analysis: a reproducible pipeline (downloads with hashes and manifests, explicit typing and validation, time and geography alignment, just-enough transformation, a documented data product), RO-Crate 1.3 metadata with Process Run Crate provenance and validation, and investigating and encoding data licences.
interface.developerName: Stian Soiland-Reyes, The University of Manchester
defaultPrompt: Set up a reproducible download and validation pipeline for this dataset, recording provenance.
Describe the files in this directory as an RO-Crate 1.3 and validate it.
Find out under what licence we may redistribute this dataset, and record the evidence.
